scoring_justification: Recompute the analytical curves from the coupled vibration model using standard PZT-4 constants embedded in the checker; compare the agent's reported values field-by-field within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Standard PZT-4 material constants used to recompute the reference curves.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Berlincourt et al. 1964, IEEE Standard 176, PZT-4 typical constants consistent with the paper's factor 0.24 in Eq. (46).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Constants were selected from known published tables for PZT-4 ceramic: c11E=13.9e10 N/m², c12E=7.78e10, c13E=7.43e10, c33E=11.5e10, e31=-6.5 C/m², e33=15.1 C/m², ε33S=5.87e-9 F/m, ρ=7500 kg/m³, k33=0.7, tall-rod keff=0.59. These values are used exclusively in the checker's recomputation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These constants are widely published and necessary to define the analytical model; they are not fabricated or derived from the paper's final numbers.

outputs.description: The computed normalized resonance frequencies and effective coupling coefficients for the two coupled vibration branches as a function of the aspect ratio h/2a.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker independently recomputes the analytical curves using the same PZT-4 material constants and the same model equations, then compares the agent's submitted values within a tolerance field by field.
